A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same 29-page study, including complete Appendices A–M. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish matching research content, with differences confined to the arXiv version/date stamp and PDF metadata.

before.justification: v1 reports original human evaluations of generated data, multiple-choice experiments, and generation evaluations in Tables 1 and 4–6, with further empirical analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including model comparisons, human preference assessments, and appendix agreement analyses.

M1.justification: The source-grounded instruction generation, GPT-4o selection, manual verification, and model fine-tuning procedures are identical in both versions.

E1.justification: Both versions use GovSet, CultSet, Kazakh Alpaca, and the same three MCQ benchmarks. Question answering and conversational evaluation coverage also remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same generation-model and MURI comparisons. Table 4 retains the same Vanilla, RAG, Alpaca, Ours, and Alpaca + Ours columns; generation evaluations retain the same vanilla counterparts.

E3.justification: The 90/10 split, evaluation sample sizes, zero-shot scoring, generation metrics, retrieval settings, and fine-tuning configurations in Sections 4–5 are identical.

E4.justification: The topic-wise preference analysis in Appendix B, instruction distributions in Appendix D, and error analyses and annotation examples in Table 3 and Appendices C, G, and H are unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical, including Pearson correlation and Cohen's kappa agreement analyses in Sections 4.2 and 5.2 and Appendix K. No run, seed, or uncertainty-reporting information changes.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings match, including appendix plots. For example, Table 4 retains Qwen's Constitution accuracies of 0.670 for Ours and 0.680 for Alpaca + Ours.

T1.justification: Mathematical notation and assumptions are unchanged. Neither version contains formal theoretical results or proofs that are added, removed, or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: a manually verified 10,600-example Kazakh dataset, comparison of LLM-assisted generation, and instruction-tuning benefits.

C2.justification: Interpretations of RAG, automatic metrics, and preference results are identical. Limitations concerning cultural coverage, dialects, modeling choices, and institutional data drift also remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Fine-tuning hyperparameters, retrieval details, Appendix A prompts, annotation guidance, and research-resource access information are unchanged. The updated PDF metadata supplies no new implementation or code/data access details.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the reference list are identical, with no added or removed cited works or changes to research positioning.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv margin text changes from v1, 19 Feb 2025 to v2, 31 Aug 2025. The title, authors, prose, section order, and appendix organization are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–8, Tables 1–20, captions, and placement are unchanged. Rendered pages 2–29 match exactly, and first-page visual differences are confined to the updated arXiv stamp.

improvement.justification: The research text, results, figures, tables, and Appendices A–M are unchanged. Updating the arXiv stamp and PDF metadata produces no meaningful difference in scientific support, clarity, reproducibility, or overall paper quality.
